biggest_catch: You need a referral link from an existing Freetrade customer (new customers cannot self-generate one) - and you must fund at least £50 net within 30 days.
catches: Requires signing up via an existing customer's unique referral link; links may not be promoted publicly (only shared with family/friends)
New customer (Recipient) must pass onboarding checks, complete a W-8BEN form, and fund with at least £50 net (top-ups minus withdrawals) in the first 30 days
Free share is randomly selected from US/UK companies, ETFs, and trusts, worth £10-£100; probability is weighted so more expensive shares are rarer
Free share revealed and dropped into the General Investment Account within 7-10 days of qualifying
Freetrade may claw back, sell, or cancel free shares for material breach of the referral terms; 10 free shares per calendar month cap for referrers

c1.evidence: Freetrade (freetrade.io) - UK FCA-regulated broker. Official 'Get a free share, refer a friend' page plus official 'Free Share Terms & Conditions' on se.freetrade.io, fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official: 'Refer a friend to Freetrade from your app and you'll both get a free share worth between £10 and £100.' Recipient terms: award a Free Share when the Recipient uses a Referral Link, passes onboarding, completes W-8BEN, and funds with at least £50 net.

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: referral link, onboarding, W-8BEN, £50+ net funding within 30 days.

c4.evidence: Free share has no entry cost beyond the user's own £50 deposit (which remains theirs). Not pay-to-play.

eligibility: New Freetrade customers who sign up via an existing customer's referral link, pass onboarding, complete W-8BEN, and fund £50+ net within 30 days.
notes: G54 brokerage wave 2. Official provider-owned terms on freetrade.io. Note the referral-link requirement is a real friction: the user needs a link from a real Freetrade customer.
numeric_basis: payout from official page (£10-£100, represented approx. US$13-$130); time: signup + onboarding + funding est. 30-45 min active

steps: Sign up for Freetrade using an existing customer's unique referral link
Pass onboarding checks and complete the W-8BEN form
Fund the account with at least £50 net within 30 days
Receive a free share worth £10-£100 in your General Investment Account within 7-10 days
timing: Ongoing referral program; free share dropped 7-10 days after qualifying.
